lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized in approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the circular clusters, forming identifiable anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features on the upper flank displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance above and shadow below.
